# Octofit-tracker Fitness App Django Cosmetic Frontend Guidelines

## General Guidelines


- "High-fidelity UI/UX design of a modern SaaS dashboard, 
- dark mode with deep navy and charcoal tones, vibrant glassmorphism widgets, neon accent colors (electric blue and violet), clean sans-serif typography. 
- Features: interactive data visualization charts, 3D floating elements, sidebar navigation with glowing icons. Soft animations suggested by motion blur, ultra-minimalist, 8k resolution, trending on Dribbble and Behance."
